criteria.intent: Mandatory substantive independent subagent review after each work iteration
criteria.automated_scope: Existing guide/style routing and bounds checks establish mechanical structure only. Independent semantic review must inspect the actual rule, independence and iteration/correction/unavailable-review cases.

criteria.intent: Recoverable iteration and correction review evidence without recursive paperwork
criteria.automated_scope: Existing catalog/freshness and route checks establish navigation and source identities only. They cannot establish that a subagent performed a substantive review or accepted dispositions.

criteria.intent: Focused current-source integration, bounded checks, independent review and normal merge
criteria.automated_scope: Basic, style, current navigation and RI/CI checks cover their existing mechanical subsets. Independent review must inspect the complete diff, unchanged site/docs and CS applicability; actual GitHub linkage, merge decision and merged-source verification remain external.

REVIEW.description: Actual independent non-implementing reviewer subagent examines current instructions/templates/config/policy and original ACs, challenges representative iteration/correction/rebase/status/unavailable-review cases, records identity/source/findings/dispositions and rechecks any substantive corrections. Inspect unchanged public/runtime scope and applicable CS01/CS04/CS05/CS08/CS09/CS10; no automatic semantic approval.

LIVE.description: Fetch exact issue/PR/Refs commits/checks and review evidence; reconcile actual issue checkboxes, reviewed source identity and current CI. Local results do not supply a remote CI pass.

MERGED.description: Applicable maintainer merge decision, actual protected-main merge and accepted-source/tree verification before issue closure. This documentation change grants no deployment/publication authority.
